truth: CORE-01, CORE-02, CORE-03 and CORE-04 are closed as construction dependencies. PLATFORM-00 is ACTIVE incomplete; DAW-00 is PRESERVED incomplete; OPS-04 is dependency-ready.

PLATFORM-00A environment/roots, B process identity/instance lease, C support policy/acceptance evidence and D release-artifact provenance/authenticated-manifest trust are implemented on stacked mergeable draft PRs #29, #36, #37 and #38.

PLATFORM-00D exact head cf00c3f32449cf1f08a41d56548815ed9a643c92 is the PLATFORM-00E baseline. artifacts.py blob a9f7efd497d9cc970cca5220d9eeb473feb6cd81 is byte-identical to its 20-case local harness; hosted exact-head execution is UNOBSERVED.

PLATFORM-00 closure audit found one remaining shared architecture primitive: the accepted platform policy requires out-of-process architecture-specific workers where practical, while AUDIO-02 owns actual plugin discovery/hosting.

PLATFORM-00E is the only active increment. WorkerEnvelope models worker identity, capability, exact request routing and truthful result validation only; it performs no subprocess, IPC, plugin loading or audio processing.
WorkerIdentity binds worker kind, exact platform/architecture and build-artifact SHA-256. PID/process ownership remains PLATFORM-00B and is not duplicated here.

NATIVE_ONLY requires worker and workload architecture to match the main application target. ISOLATED_FOREIGN_ARCH may represent a foreign architecture only when the exact isolated worker declares it, the workload matches the worker architecture and OS family remains the same.
The main N0TE application target is never rewritten to the worker/workload architecture. A bridge route is an explicit isolated route, not an in-process compatibility claim.

WorkerRequest binds exact worker, support target, job, format, workload architecture, payload fingerprint and positive timeout budget. Wrong worker/target/job/format/architecture is rejected before dispatch.

WorkerResult states SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CRASHED, TIMED_OUT and UNKNOWN are distinct. Only SUCCEEDED may carry result fingerprint plus receipt, and stale results for another request/worker are rejected.

The published n0te2/worker.py blob 6b9c9d96c9cf5bf3d7e81d6517cf2a0679d15f8d is byte-identical to the implementation that passed a 20-case local adversarial harness. Repository regressions are authored; full hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
WorkerEnvelope exposes only plan and validate_result, with no spawn/subprocess/IPC/load/process-audio/install/kill/execute/connect behavior.
No plug-in format is claimed hosted by PLATFORM-00E. Actual scan/load/process/state support remains AUDIO-02, and real platform packages/signing/acceptance remain APP-01 + PLATFORM-01/02/03/REL.
Windows and Linux remain peer consumer platforms with macOS. Historical platform or DAW maturity has zero scheduling priority.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
